fusions.name: Thousandth Kick
fusions.desc: A practised kick that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Flawless Roundhouse
fusions.desc: A spinning kick that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Reset Stance
fusions.desc: Hops you 2 tiles from where you stood and clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Muscle Memory
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (16% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
